description: This file implements a class for decoding HTTP chunked transfer encoding, including parsing chunk sizes, handling buffer filtering, and managing chunk boundaries. It is part of the networking code in Chromium, derived from Mozilla's implementation.

classes.name: HttpChunkedDecoder
classes.description: A class responsible for decoding HTTP chunked transfer encoding streams, managing buffer filtering, chunk size parsing, and state transitions.

methods.name: FilterBuf
methods.description: Filters and processes the input buffer to decode chunked data, handling chunk boundaries and end-of-file conditions.

methods.name: ScanForChunkRemaining
methods.description: Scans the buffer for the next chunk size line, parses chunk size, and updates decoding state.

methods.name: ParseChunkSize
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal chunk size string, ensuring strict format and converting it to an integer.
